author: Thich Nhat Hanh
explanation: This celebrated instruction summarizes the essence of engaged Buddhist practice. In a culture driven by frantic rush and adrenaline, pausing to offer the body a gentle smile, relaxing the diaphragm, and decelerating our pace restores instant harmony.
practicalInsight: Whenever you feel hurried or stressed today, pause for three conscious in-and-out breaths, relax your shoulders, and smile gently.
reflectionPrompt: What are you rushing toward today, and what would happen if you decelerated by 20% to actually inhabit your life?
